subject: Insurance
title: California's Wildfire Insurance Crisis
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on California's Wildfire Insurance Crisis.

hook.text: The 2018 Camp Fire destroyed Paradise, California, killing 85. Insurance claims topped $12 billion.

buildup.text: Wildfire losses in California tripled between 2015 and 2020.

discovery.text: Major insurers like State Farm and Allstate stopped writing new home policies in fire-prone areas.

twist.text: California's FAIR Plan—the insurer of last resort—saw enrollment surge 40%.

climax.text: California's wildfire crisis is a preview: climate change is making some risks uninsurable. The market is retreating.

quiz.question: Why are major insurers leaving California?
options: Wildfire losses made the market unprofitable
